description: NaBaNd(GeO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.84 Å. Ba is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.74-3.14 Å. Nd is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.43 Å. There are three inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.83 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.74 Å) and two longer (1.82 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. In the third Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.84 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ba, one Nd, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Ge atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Ge atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Nd, and one Ge atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Ge atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Nd, and one Ge atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ba, one Nd, and one Ge atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Nd, and one Ge atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Nd, and one Ge atom.
